lifeRememberedMost.citation: The most events a person keeps one by one before the least important and oldest fold into a count by kind and decade (owner, Oct 11, 2026: memories keep what matters and summarize the rest). Set so a played life of several decades still shows every loss, child, partner and conviction it held.

spread.citation: Checked range, not a measure: the long-save speed check (npm run speed:year) reads records kept per person at year 100 against year 4.
